title: Validation warning baseline
description: The set of warning signatures deliberately carried, so a new warning is distinguishable from a deferred one. Lives under system/contracts/ rather than system/schema/ because it governs an operational record, not a canonical record — the data contract fingerprints only the record schemas.

baseline_version.description: Bumped when the signature shape changes, not when the baseline is re-adopted.

recorded.description: The day this set was adopted.

note.description: Why the baseline stands where it does. Required: an unexplained baseline move is indistinguishable from a silent regression.

total.description: Reported, never asserted as a permanent expected value. The gate is the per-signature comparison below.

path.description: Repository-relative location the warning was reported against; empty for repository-wide warnings.

count.description: Multiplicity. Growth is a regression even when the total is unchanged.
